description:
As a bank customer
  I want to move money and review activity
  So that I can trust my balance and history

elements.name: Customer deposits money and sees the transaction

steps.name: the banking login page is open
I click "Customer Login"
I select customer "Harry Potter" from the dropdown
I click "Login"
I should see the customer account area
I open the "Deposit" tab
I enter "100" into the deposit amount field
I submit the deposit
I open the "Transactions" tab
I should see a deposit transaction for amount "100"

elements.name: Customer withdraws money and sees a debit transaction

steps.name: the banking login page is open
I click "Customer Login"
I select customer "Harry Potter" from the dropdown
I click "Login"
I should see the customer account area
I open the "Deposit" tab
I enter "500" into the deposit amount field
I submit the deposit
I open the "Withdrawl" tab
I enter "100" into the withdraw amount field
I submit the withdraw
I open the "Transactions" tab
I should see a withdraw transaction for amount "100"
